### Community Pulse Survey

The **Community Pulse Survey** is circulated periodically with four short questions to gauge member sentiment and the value Collaboratory provides. Select a tab below to view results from each round.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## June 2025

**`r jun_n` responses** received: `r jun_languages`.

Collaboratory's **Net Promoter Score: `r nps_score_jun`** — Promoters (`r jun_promoters`%), Passives (`r jun_passives`%), Detractors (`r jun_detractors`%).

#### Member Satisfaction

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
ggplot(satisfaction_summary_jun, aes(x = Satisfaction, y = pct)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, fill = "#00205C") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Member Satisfaction", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "none"
  )
```

#### Collaboratory Value

Members take value from the following areas offered by Collaboratory. The highest value offering is **attending events (webinars, meetings, workshops, etc) at 89%**.

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
ggplot(survey_summary_jun, aes(x = Question, y = pct_signed, fill = Response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette, name = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = question_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Have the following Collaboratory offerings added value to your work?",
    x = "", y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "bottom"
  )
```

### Trends at a Glance

A directional comparison between the two survey rounds. Note: December 2025 had a smaller sample (`r dec_n` vs `r jun_n` responses), so shifts should be interpreted as indicative rather than definitive.

| Metric | June 2025 | December 2025 | Direction |
|--------|-----------|---------------|-----------|
| Net Promoter Score | `r nps_score_jun` | `r nps_score_dec` | `r if(nps_score_dec > nps_score_jun + 3) "↑" else if(nps_score_dec < nps_score_jun - 3) "↓" else "→"` |
| Positive Satisfaction | `r round(jun_sat_pos, 1)`% | `r round(dec_sat_pos, 1)`% | `r trend_arrow(dec_sat_pos, jun_sat_pos)` |
| Responses | `r jun_n` | `r dec_n` | `r if(dec_n > jun_n + 2) "↑" else if(dec_n < jun_n - 2) "↓" else "→"` |
